scripts.lint: pnpm run lint::core && npm run lint::bolt-connection && pnpm run lint::bolt-connection && pnpm run lint::neo4j-driver-lite && pnpm run lint::neo4j-driver && pnpm run lint::testkit-backend && pnpm run lint::benchkit-backend
scripts.lint::core: pnpm run ts-standard::core -- packages/core/src/ && pnpm run ts-standard::core -- packages/core/test/
scripts.lint::bolt-connection: pnpm run ts-standard::bolt-connection -- packages/bolt-connection/types/ && pnpm run standard -- packages/bolt-connection/src/ && pnpm run standard -- packages/bolt-connection/test/
scripts.lint::neo4j-driver-lite: pnpm run ts-standard::neo4j-driver-lite -- packages/neo4j-driver-lite/src/ && pnpm run ts-standard::neo4j-driver-lite -- packages/neo4j-driver-lite/test/
scripts.lint::neo4j-driver: pnpm run ts-standard::neo4j-driver -- packages/neo4j-driver/types/ && pnpm run ts-standard::neo4j-driver -- packages/neo4j-driver/test/types/ && pnpm run standard -- packages/neo4j-driver/src/ && pnpm run standard -- packages/neo4j-driver/test/**/*.js
scripts.ts-standard: pnpm run ts-standard::core && pnpm run ts-standard::bolt-connection && pnpm run ts-standard::neo4j-driver-lite && pnpm run ts-standard::neo4j-driver
